quest.cafe_guest.desc: Leafing through the guest book by the stairs in the Saucer, I realised the pages are running out and my entry is not there.
quest.cafe_guest.done: Done. The barista, passing, glanced over my shoulder and nodded: "Now you're one of ours."
quest.cafe_guest.sign.log: The pen is right there. If I have no thoughts, I can draw a saucer.
quest.cafe_guest.sign.obj: Write an entry in the guest book
quest.cafe_guest.title: A page in the guest book
quest.cafe_kesha.desc: A sheet under the menu says Kesha the parrot has come back on his own. He likes sunflower seeds and the word "Terminus". Worth checking.
quest.cafe_kesha.done: A pastry on the house. Kesha announced the last stop aloud, and then I thought he added "See you soon".
quest.cafe_kesha.feed.log: Kesha is watching me with one eye. The saucer says: first "Terminus", then the seeds.
quest.cafe_kesha.perch.log: Seeds in my pocket. I'll go to the perch at the end of the bar in the Saucer and take a look at Kesha.
quest.cafe_kesha.perch.obj: Talk to Kesha on his perch by the bar
quest.cafe_kesha.seeds.log: I need sunflower seeds. They say you can buy them at the market.
quest.cafe_kesha.title: Terminus
quest.checkup.desc: At the clinic they looked at me as if I'd been due for a check-up for ages. Well, if they've been waiting.
quest.checkup.doctor.log: Only the doctor left. He sees patients on weekdays until five.
quest.checkup.done: "Practically healthy," they wrote on my card. The nurse gave me a boiled sweet as if I were little. I didn't refuse.
quest.checkup.nurse.log: The nurse told me to step on the scales and read the eye chart. Then the doctor.
quest.checkup.title: Practically healthy
quest.chess_ladder.desc: In the club a ladder of names is chalked on a board. The bottom line is empty, and for some reason I feel awkward walking past it.
quest.chess_ladder.done: I wrote my name on the empty line. In chalk, small, so it can be rubbed out. Lev Markovich read it and nodded: that is how everybody starts.
quest.chess_ladder.play.log: Now I can sit down at a board. If I lose they will pour me tea; that's the custom here.
quest.chess_ladder.play.obj: Play a game of chess at the Rassvet
quest.chess_ladder.read.log: Before sitting down at a board I'll check the shelf: there should be a book of openings.
quest.chess_ladder.title: A rung of the ladder
quest.cinema_night.desc: They're showing a film at the Rassvet. The poster promises everyone cries at the end, even the projectionist.
quest.cinema_night.done: I came out of the cinema and the light outside had changed. For five minutes the town seemed like the film carrying on.
quest.cinema_night.film.log: A ticket is thirty roubles; the show runs while the projectionist is in, from three till late. I'll sit wherever I like.
quest.cinema_night.title: The evening show
quest.cinema_night.watch.obj: Watch a film at the Rassvet
quest.city_tour.desc: The town is big and I don't know anyone in it. I'll start by just walking through the main doors.
quest.city_tour.done: I've been round the whole centre. Every door greeted me as if I'd been there before.
quest.city_tour.see_cafe.obj: Go up to the Saucer café
quest.city_tour.see_club.obj: Look into the Rassvet culture house
quest.city_tour.title: The town by the sea
quest.city_tour.walk.log: The library, the department store, the market, the Rassvet, the clinic, the Saucer café. If I do something in each one, sit down, leaf through a book, buy something, maybe the town will remember me.
quest.clinic_fish.bottle.log: The aquarium needs water of my own. The pharmacy window sells water.
quest.clinic_fish.desc: A single fish lives in the clinic, and the children call it the Head Doctor. They say it is lonely.
quest.clinic_fish.done: The jar clinked. The nurse nodded and pressed a few roubles into my hand for the fare: "Not for the money, for the care." The Head Doctor, I think, swam by a little more briskly.
quest.clinic_fish.jar.log: Only the jar on the reception desk is left: drop a coin in.
quest.clinic_fish.jar.obj: Drop a coin in the jar
quest.clinic_fish.notice.log: A note about the fish hangs on the board in the hall. I should read what they ask.
quest.clinic_fish.pour.log: The watering can is beside the aquarium. Time to top up the water.
quest.clinic_fish.read.obj: Read the note on the board
quest.clinic_fish.title: A Friend for the Head Doctor
quest.clinic_ticket.desc: There is a squared-up chair by the door of Room 4. Nobody sits on it. I wonder why.
quest.clinic_ticket.done: A plate like any plate. But when the instruments clinked behind the door I wanted to move seats. I console myself that my blood pressure is an astronaut's.
quest.clinic_ticket.door.log: Now I can stand by the dentist's door and read the plate. Just read it.
quest.clinic_ticket.door.obj: Read the plate on the door of Room 4
quest.clinic_ticket.height.obj: Measure my height at the wall
quest.clinic_ticket.prep.log: Before going near that door I should be in order: height and blood pressure with the nurse.
quest.clinic_ticket.title: A Ticket to the Dentist
quest.cog_clock.desc: The Cog club's chess clock has gone missing. Everyone seems to know it's gone and nobody knows where.
quest.cog_clock.done: The buffet lady brought tea and a biscuit "for the return". She said the clock came back the most proper way: by itself. I didn't argue.
quest.cog_clock.find.log: Something ticks upstairs. Grasshoppers don't live indoors, but circles do.
quest.cog_clock.look.log: I'll start with the notices: the club's boards usually say more than whoever wrote them meant to.
quest.cog_clock.notices.obj: Read the notices on the club's boards
quest.cog_clock.place.obj: Put the clock back on the chess table
quest.cog_clock.set.log: Seryozha asked me to take the clock back so he wouldn't have to explain. I'll put it in its place and nobody will have to explain anything.
quest.cog_clock.title: The cracked clock
quest.cog_reader.cart.log: Last, a look at the returns trolley: you can see who read what, which is almost like meeting them.
quest.cog_reader.desc: The club library doesn't lend books to just anyone, but the magazines go round freely. I'll start at the shelves.
quest.cog_reader.done: Tamara Ilyinichna stamped "Cog Club. Library" on a postcard and said I was a reader now. The stamp came out crooked, but it's real.
quest.cog_reader.look.obj: See what has been returned to the trolley
quest.cog_reader.read.log: Chess, engineering, the sea. In the margins of every book someone has already argued with the author.
quest.cog_reader.swap.log: By the end wall there is a swap rack: bring one, take one. I have nothing yet, but they let you take a magazine anyway.
quest.cog_reader.take.obj: Take a magazine from the swap rack
quest.cog_reader.title: A reader at the club
quest.commune_cat.board.log: The committee board by the entrance. I'll read the news about the cat.
quest.commune_cat.desc: The house committee board asks people not to feed Markiz the cat and to report where he was seen. He has been seen everywhere.
quest.commune_cat.done: Markiz came to the film, sat on the committee's bench and watched to the end. I got the place beside him. The committee poured tea for us both, his in a saucer.
quest.commune_cat.evening.log: The committee invites everyone to the television evening, Markiz too. I'll sit near him.
quest.commune_cat.fold_laundry.obj: Sort the laundry on the table by the washers
quest.commune_cat.lost_box.obj: Look in the lost-property box by the door
quest.commune_cat.read_board.obj: Read the house committee board in the hall
quest.commune_cat.search.log: They say the cat likes things warm and soft. I'll check the basket by the folding table and the lost-property box.
quest.commune_cat.title: The Cat in the Sailor Vest
quest.commune_cat.watch_tv.obj: Watch the television in the hall
quest.commune_cloud.board.log: The committee board by the entrance has a sheet for every day. I'll read what it says today.
quest.commune_cloud.desc: By the door of the commune's hall hangs the house committee's report about a leak. I'd like to know how it all ended.
quest.commune_cloud.done: After the programme Lidia Arkadyevna led everyone to see the little cloud on the ceiling in 1-05, with a kettle instead of a pointer. They poured me tea: viewers are entitled to it, they said.
quest.commune_cloud.evening.log: The committee calls everyone to the television evening. I'll take a seat close to the screen.
quest.commune_cloud.gossip.log: The surest news is found at the chess board and in the wall newspaper. I'll look in at both.
quest.commune_cloud.play_chess.obj: Sit down with the chess players by the wall
quest.commune_cloud.read_board.obj: Read the house committee board in the hall
quest.commune_cloud.title: A Cloud on the Ceiling
quest.commune_cloud.watch_tv.obj: Watch the television in the hall
quest.fair_record.desc: At the fair's strongman gauge hangs a plaque with somebody's record. A tripod stands next to it. I want to leave a mark too.
quest.fair_record.done: A new print in my diary: me at the gauge, the bell overhead, my eyes just above the record number. The photographer signed the back and added, "Third place is waiting."
quest.fair_record.hit.log: Now the mallet. Two roubles is cheap for the right to ring the bell.
quest.fair_record.photo.log: The photographer promised to shoot those who hit the gauge. I'll go to the tripod.
quest.fair_record.pose.obj: Have my photo taken at the tripod
quest.fair_record.read.obj: Read the record plaque by the strongman gauge
quest.fair_record.record.log: First I'll read the plaque: I need to know which number to reach for.
quest.fair_record.title: A record at the bell
quest.fair_sandal.basket.log: The Lost and Found basket stands by the chair scales. I'll take it there.
quest.fair_sandal.desc: On the fair's notice board hangs a note about a child's sandal. The left one is looking for the right one. Or the other way round.
quest.fair_sandal.done: The pair met. They say that at that moment somewhere at the fair a girl in one sandal stopped limping.
quest.fair_sandal.find.log: The thing to do is look under a bench. Fine, I'll look under a bench.
quest.fair_sandal.fortune.log: The fortune-telling automaton talks about lost things. I'll ask it, just in case.
quest.fair_sandal.look.obj: Find the sandal under a bench among the kiosks
quest.fair_sandal.notice.log: First I'll read the notice on the board, in case there are details.
quest.fair_sandal.put.obj: Put the sandal in the Lost and Found basket by the scales
quest.fair_sandal.read.obj: Read the notices on the fair's board
quest.fair_sandal.title: A sandal under the bench
quest.first_chess.desc: At the Cog club there are people at the chess tables who never seem to get up.
quest.first_chess.done: After the game the buffet lady brought me tea "for bravery". She said losers always get a glass here.
quest.first_chess.game.log: I'll sit at a free board. Someone is bound to join me; that's the custom here.
quest.first_chess.play.obj: Play a game of chess at the Cog club
quest.first_chess.title: First game
quest.hall_dance_night.book.log: After the dancing it is the custom to write one's impressions in the guest book in the foyer. Almost a compulsory item of the programme.
quest.hall_dance_night.book.obj: Leave an entry in the guest book in the foyer
quest.hall_dance_night.desc: The poster in the lobby announces a dance night. Better not to stand by the wall but to step onto the floor. First, though, I must work out what is expected of me.
quest.hall_dance_night.done: I wrote: "Came in for a minute, stayed for a waltz." The caretaker nodded: that is exactly what everyone writes who comes again. And poured me some tea.
quest.hall_dance_night.floor.log: My feet seem to obey. Time to step onto the dance floor.
quest.hall_dance_night.mirror.log: First a rehearsal in front of the mirror: the side hall has a barre and a wall-sized mirror.
quest.hall_dance_night.mirror.obj: Stand at the barre mirror in the dance room
quest.hall_dance_night.title: Dancing at the Vaults
quest.hall_premiere.board.log: A notice from the Wave theatre is pinned by the entrance. I'll read what they have for today.
quest.hall_premiere.board.obj: Read the theatre's notice in the lobby
quest.hall_premiere.desc: In the Assembly Hall an amateur theatre is preparing the play Time, Forward! They say the club's chess clock was last seen somewhere other than the club. I'll look in; maybe I will be of use.
quest.hall_premiere.done: The echo clapped along with the hall, and the caretaker-Clockmaker bowed as if he really had stopped time. At the door the caretaker pressed forty roubles into my hand: "For paying attention. Buy a pie at the buffet and tell the chess players about the clock."
quest.hall_premiere.props.log: They need a big clock and the club is looking for a small one. I'll look at the props table backstage: maybe the two will meet.
quest.hall_premiere.props.obj: Look over the props table backstage
quest.hall_premiere.show.log: All is ready. I'll take a seat in the hall and watch Time go forward.
quest.hall_premiere.show.obj: Watch the play from a seat in the hall
quest.hall_premiere.title: Premiere at the Vaults
quest.home_aoki.desc: The seamstress Rimma Aoki lives at the top of the second stepped house. The door is open; a clock ticks and fabric rustles in the draught.
quest.home_aoki.done: At the Rassvet the cashier heard me out and wrote in her book: "Sun: will be there." She gave me twenty-five roubles "for the tram". There are no trams in Lyudmilovsk. "Well, for the cable car, then," said the cashier.
quest.home_aoki.dress.log: Something almost finished under the machine's needle. I'll see what.
quest.home_aoki.dress.obj: Look at the sewing under the needle
quest.home_aoki.fitting.log: By her calendar, the costume fitting for the Rassvet is on Thursday, and the Sun for the play isn't ready. I'll look in at the Rassvet and tell them the Sun is being sewn and will be there.
quest.home_aoki.fitting.obj: Tell the cashier at the Rassvet's ticket window
quest.home_aoki.swatches.log: One sun on the hem isn't finished: she couldn't find the right yellow. There are swatches on the wall. Maybe I can find it.
quest.home_aoki.swatches.obj: Pick out a yellow among the swatches on the wall
quest.home_aoki.title: A sun for the hem
quest.home_girma.calendar.log: On Friday Mum comes home. I'll mark it too, just a little, on the family calendar.
quest.home_girma.calendar.obj: Mark Friday on the family calendar
quest.home_girma.charts.log: Daisuke has a whole shelf of star charts. One of them, they say, has the sun drawn on it, at night. I'll find which.
quest.home_girma.charts.obj: Find the star chart with the sun drawn on it
quest.home_girma.desc: The Girmas live at the top of the stepped house: Daisuke, the dad, sells at the market; Nino, the mum, works away; and eight-year-old Tomohiko draws. The terrace door is open.
quest.home_girma.done: On the stairs I met a boy with a satchel. "Did you look with the filter?" "With the filter." "Good, then," said Tomo, and gave me thirty roubles from his money box "for keeping an eye on Papa's telescope". I tried to refuse. "Mama told me to keep watch, and I was at school. So you were working."
quest.home_girma.scope.log: Tomo drew the sun on the night chart. His dad draws the real one every day, through a filter. I'll look through the telescope too. Filter on.
quest.home_girma.scope.obj: Look at the sun through the filtered telescope
quest.home_girma.title: A sun on the night chart
quest.home_holm.desc: The door of a ground-floor flat is wide open. A plate on it: "V. S. Holm, Ocean Navigator." Nobody home, only a clock ticking.
quest.home_holm.done: Without looking up from her knitting, the concierge handed me forty roubles. "Viktor Sergeyevich said: whoever writes the forecast in for him gets ice-cream money. He tells everyone that. You're the first who did."
quest.home_holm.log.obj: Find the watch log on the shelf of pilot books
quest.home_holm.radio.log: His receiver is broken and there's been no forecast in the log for three days. There's a house radio down in the hall. I'll listen for him.
quest.home_holm.radio.obj: Hear the forecast on the radio in the hall
quest.home_holm.read.log: Among his pilot books there's a watch log. Someone else's, of course. I'll just take a look.
quest.home_holm.title: Shore watch
quest.home_holm.write.log: The log lies on the kitchen table, open at today's date. I'll write the forecast in. In my own hand, but neatly.
quest.home_holm.write.obj: Write the forecast in the log in the kitchen
quest.home_kravets.answer.log: Found the time. I'll write it into a corner of the chart on her wall, small, in pencil, so she can rub it out if she wants to solve it herself.
quest.home_kravets.answer.obj: Write the time on the chart on Nora's wall
quest.home_kravets.desc: A student lives by the entrance of the second capsule tower. The door's open, with a note: "Nora Kravets is at the library. Quiet: thinking in progress."
quest.home_kravets.done: Down at the desk there's a box labelled "For whoever helps Nora with physics". The whole building has been dropping coins in since the start of term. They gave me twenty roubles and told me not to tell anyone. I'm not telling. Just writing.
quest.home_kravets.problem.log: Exercise books on the desk. I'll have a look: maybe I'll understand what the thinking's about.
quest.home_kravets.problem.obj: Look at the exercise books on Nora's desk
quest.home_kravets.tides.log: The problem's about tomorrow's high water at the pier. The lighthouse keepers' log is sure to have the tides. I'll go to the lighthouse.
quest.home_kravets.tides.obj: Find the tide table in the lighthouse keepers' log
quest.home_kravets.title: High water
quest.home_okada.canvas.log: I'll see what's on his easel today. Only look.
quest.home_okada.canvas.obj: Look at the canvas on the easel
quest.home_okada.desc: A door on the curved slab's gallery stands ajar; it smells of turpentine. The caretaker downstairs told me: "That's Lev Markovich Okada. He's been painting the same window a thousand times."
quest.home_okada.done: Downstairs, Asanov the caretaker poured me a glass of tea in a holder. "Been up to Markovich's? He asked me: whoever comes and really looks at the paintings, pour them one." I didn't ask how he knew it was really.
quest.home_okada.letter.log: A letter lies on the dining table. You don't read other people's letters. But sitting down next to it is probably allowed.
quest.home_okada.letter.obj: Sit down at the table with the letter
quest.home_okada.title: A thousand and one windows
quest.home_okada.wall.log: Today's canvas was begun and dropped mid-word. Maybe the big picture over the sofa will explain the thousand identical windows.
quest.home_okada.wall.obj: Study the big picture over the sofa
quest.home_okafor.cafe.log: The tune breaks off at three minutes. Someone has added a fresh note on the reel: the Saucer café, the jukebox, third button. I'll check.
quest.home_okafor.cafe.obj: Play the jukebox at the Saucer café
quest.home_okafor.desc: In the capsule house on the slope, one pair of capsules has been turned into a radio amateur's den. A plate: "Gunnar Okafor. Lyudmilovsk-11." The door's open and something inside is hissing softly.
quest.home_okafor.done: The neighbour from the capsule opposite looked out at the rustling. "You found him that tune? He's been looking for half a year!" And she pressed thirty roubles on me "from the whole building". I didn't cross out "unknown" on the reel: let it be both.
quest.home_okafor.record.log: That's the one, right to the end, no static! Now to find the record on Gunnar's shelf and write the title on the reel.
quest.home_okafor.record.obj: Find the record on the music shelf
quest.home_okafor.tape.log: There's a reel on the tape recorder. I'll switch it on, just to listen.
quest.home_okafor.tape.obj: Listen to the reel on Gunnar's tape recorder
quest.home_okafor.title: The third button
quest.home_okonkwo.barber.log: Emiliano's mum, Yasmin, works as a barber on the promenade, in the barber's nearer the fair square. I'll tell her the whale's in one piece and waiting for Saturday.
quest.home_okonkwo.barber.obj: Sit in the waiting chair at the promenade barber's where Yasmin works
quest.home_okonkwo.desc: In the second house of two drums there's Mads Okonkwo's pottery studio. It smells of wet clay. Nobody inside, only the wheel under a cloth.
quest.home_okonkwo.done: Yasmin laughed without letting go of her scissors. "In one piece? Thank goodness. I water it every morning like a plant." She gave me thirty roubles "for delivering the news" and asked me not to tell Emiliano the whale will have two tails. It's a surprise.
quest.home_okonkwo.drawings.log: The whale is waiting for Papa. The board of drawings should show when he's coming back.
quest.home_okonkwo.drawings.obj: Study the board with the calendar and drawings
quest.home_okonkwo.title: The whale on the wheel
quest.home_okonkwo.wheel.log: Something modelled under the cloth. I'll look without touching anything.
quest.home_okonkwo.wheel.obj: See what's on the potter's wheel
quest.home_santos.board.log: A notice board in the kitchen. Family business, of course, but isn't a board there to be looked at?
quest.home_santos.board.obj: Read the board in the kitchen
quest.home_santos.desc: The blue house in the folded row. The door's open; five pairs of shoes in the hall, from enormous to tiny. Nobody home: all out for a walk, it seems.
quest.home_santos.done: In a little dish on the table: sweets and a slip: "For guests. One each, please." I took one. Let the dishes go to whoever never found Venus. Which is probably Dad.
quest.home_santos.note.log: Found her! I'll leave a hint in Lina's exercise book on the children's desk. I won't be doing their dishes anyway, and it'll help her.
quest.home_santos.note.obj: Leave a hint in the exercise book on the children's desk
quest.home_santos.title: Queen of the evening
quest.home_santos.venus.log: A contest: first to see Venus gets a week off the dishes. The telescope is in the loft. Venus is the evening star: look west after sunset.
quest.home_santos.venus.obj: Find Venus with the telescope in the loft
quest.home_singh.answer.log: Gunnar lives a kilometre away, in the capsule house on the slope, and they've never met. If his door's open too, I'll answer from his own set.
quest.home_singh.answer.obj: Go on air from Gunnar's set in the capsule house
quest.home_singh.desc: The caretaker's den in the capsule tower is open, and inside the valves of a radio set are glowing. On the door: "Ilmar Singh, caretaker. On my rounds."
quest.home_singh.done: Ilmar answered himself: back from his rounds. When he heard I was sitting at Gunnar's, he was quiet for a long time, then said: "Tell him, if you see him: Saturday, the Saucer. No static." There was a stack of QSL cards under the transmitter. I took one to remember it by.
quest.home_singh.listen.log: A note on the desk: if he's on his rounds, listen on the air for him. That seems to mean me too.
quest.home_singh.listen.obj: Listen to the air on Ilmar's set
quest.home_singh.map.log: Someone called Gunnar is calling him, call sign Lyudmilovsk-11. There seems to be more about him on the wall over the desk.
quest.home_singh.map.obj: Study the map and the cards on the wall
quest.home_singh.title: A kilometre of air
quest.home_tadesse.desc: In the house of two joined drums there's a studio behind the partition. On the door: "V. Tadesse. No need to ring, come in. Don't feed the fish."
quest.home_tadesse.done: A grey-haired man came down from upstairs: the man in the portrait, half a century on. "Hamish," he said. "Here for Valya? She's on the promenade, painting water." He gave me a postcard with one of her fish. "She paints fish by the hundred. But not the sun. Not yet."
quest.home_tadesse.fish.log: Fifty-four names on the aquarium glass. I'll count how many fish there really are.
quest.home_tadesse.fish.obj: Look at the fish in the aquarium
quest.home_tadesse.paintings.log: Fish on the walls, pines, and a young man with a fishing rod. I'll look at three of the paintings in turn.
quest.home_tadesse.pines.obj: Look at the pines on the cliff
quest.home_tadesse.portrait.obj: Look at the portrait with the fishing rod
quest.home_tadesse.title: Fish and the sun
quest.honest_weight.buy.log: Apples at five roubles are sold in the fruit row.
quest.honest_weight.desc: A sign in the market says "Check your purchase!". I will: I'll buy something and put it on the control scales.
quest.honest_weight.done: It matched to the gram. The director wrote something in a big book and said: "We're rarely checked. It's good when it's not for nothing."
quest.honest_weight.tell.log: The director sits in the office by the entrance. He likes it when things add up.
quest.honest_weight.tell.obj: Tell the market director it all matched
quest.honest_weight.title: Honest weight
quest.honest_weight.weigh.log: The control scales are left of the office, next to the unlabelled jar.
quest.honest_weight.weigh.obj: Check the purchase on the control scales
quest.jam_contest.desc: The market's jam contest is over, but one jar has stayed without an owner. They say it can be tasted, but only at the weekend.
quest.jam_contest.done: The jar never found its owner. But now I know what the wind off the sea tastes like. The market director pressed a biscuit into my hand "for taking part".
quest.jam_contest.jar.log: Only the jar itself is left to see. It stands by the control scales on a little stand.
quest.jam_contest.jar.obj: Look at the unlabelled jar by the control scales
quest.jam_contest.look.log: I'll start with the jury's table by the entrance. Jars with ribbons, numbers and one mystery.
quest.jam_contest.taste.log: Tasting on Friday, Saturday and Sunday, 11 to 4. One spoon per person.
quest.jam_contest.taste.obj: Taste the jam at the tasting table
quest.jam_contest.title: The jar without a label
quest.kiosk_crossword.board.log: The crossword hangs under glass by the newspaper kiosk. I'll see what is left.
quest.kiosk_crossword.desc: Somebody solves a crossword at the stop at night, and one clue is left. The newspaper seller hints that I could manage.
quest.kiosk_crossword.done: The crossword is solved. A quiet "at last" drifted from the kiosk, and in the paper I took one word is underlined in pencil: "thanks."
quest.kiosk_crossword.look.obj: Look at the crossword by the newspaper kiosk
quest.kiosk_crossword.paper.log: The seller said a right answer earns a fresh paper: take it from the rack by the kiosk.
quest.kiosk_crossword.pencil.log: On the bench under the roof lie a paper and a pencil on a string. I'll think about the last clue.
quest.kiosk_crossword.title: Eight letters
quest.kiosk_crossword.write.obj: Write the word into the crossword on the bench
quest.kiosk_watch.desc: At the repair kiosk a tray of forgotten things has waited since spring, and a notice hangs at a stop. It looks like the same story.
quest.kiosk_watch.done: The mender said nothing, only put a cup of tea on the counter and a second beside it. I didn't ask for whom. I was given a key, "just in case."
quest.kiosk_watch.listen.obj: Listen to the pocket watch at the repair kiosk
quest.kiosk_watch.notice.log: Somebody wrote about a watch on the notices at the newspaper kiosk's stop. I'll go and read.
quest.kiosk_watch.notices.obj: Read the notices at the newspaper kiosk's stop
quest.kiosk_watch.title: The watch "L. from L."
quest.kiosk_watch.tray.log: The mender's tray holds forgotten things. I'll look at the dates.
quest.kiosk_watch.tray.obj: Look at the tray of forgotten things at the repair kiosk
quest.kiosk_watch.watch.log: Now I can go back to the watch and listen to it tick.
quest.library_1968.cup.obj: Have tea with the librarian on a Tuesday
quest.library_1968.desc: On the shelf by the east window lies a book that came back after more than half a century. The librarian says the reader will return if nobody gets in his way. Or if someone helps him a little.
quest.library_1968.done: On Tuesday the second cup was empty before I finished mine. A daisy lay on the saucer, and in the Guide my postcard stood with its writing up: "Thank you. I will come."
quest.library_1968.find.log: I'll look at the Returned shelf by the east window and at the ledger in the staff room. The door has no lock, but the Staff sign asks for quiet.
quest.library_1968.leave.log: I need a postcard: they cost four roubles at the lending desk and turn up elsewhere in town. I'll slip it into the Guide, and he will do the rest.
quest.library_1968.leave.obj: Slip the postcard into the Guide
quest.library_1968.ledger.obj: Read the ledger in the librarian's room
quest.library_1968.tea.log: The librarian said the reply will come on Tuesday, at tea time. So I wait for Tuesday.
quest.library_1968.title: The reader from 1968
quest.library_day.desc: The capsule library is quiet and smells of paper. You can sit there till closing and nobody will chase you out.
quest.library_day.done: My head is full of other people's pages. On my way out the librarian gave me a postcard: "So you have somewhere to write a thought down."
quest.library_day.read.log: I'll browse three shelves: birds, our town and the sun. There seem to be more books here about the sun than anything.
quest.library_day.title: A day at the library
quest.library_diary.ask.obj: Get a stamp from the librarian
quest.library_diary.desc: By the library door hangs a stand: every shelf has its own stamp, and the stamps are gathered in a diary. The librarian gives them to those who read for no grade.
quest.library_diary.done: There are four new stamps in the diary and a fifth, invisible one: the kind you get for a story when you are no longer five.
quest.library_diary.hour.obj: Listen to the story in the children's corner
quest.library_diary.shelves.log: To begin with, three shelves: poems, the sea and art. Leafing through is enough, the stamps go on by themselves.
quest.library_diary.stamp.log: Now to the lending desk: let the librarian look at the diary and put in her own stamp.
quest.library_diary.story.log: On weekends at 11 a story is read in the children's corner. I'll sit on a bean bag and listen; nobody will say I'm too big.
quest.library_diary.title: The reading diary
quest.lifeguard_sandal.box.log: I called out. Now I only need to look into the lost-and-found box and see how it ended.
quest.lifeguard_sandal.call.log: She is somewhere by the distant jetty, too far for a voice. I need the megaphone: it is on the shelf in the cabin.
quest.lifeguard_sandal.desc: A child's sandal has been found at the lifeguard tower. Just the one. Its owner must be upset, and I happen to have a free day.
quest.lifeguard_sandal.done: The sandal found its owner, and the owner left a shell and a drawing with the word "thanks" in it, one letter too many. The lifeguard gave me a sweet and said it was for the find.
quest.lifeguard_sandal.look.log: They are looking for the girl by description: red-haired, about seven, walking barefoot. The binoculars are in the cabin.
quest.lifeguard_sandal.notice.log: There is a notice about the find on the first tower. I should read what it says.
quest.lifeguard_sandal.read.obj: Read the lost-and-found notices on a tower
quest.lifeguard_sandal.search.obj: Look for the girl through the binoculars
quest.lifeguard_sandal.shout.obj: Call the girl with the megaphone
quest.lifeguard_sandal.title: One sandal
quest.lifeguard_thesis.board.log: First the chalk note at the tower's foot: today's figures for water and air.
quest.lifeguard_thesis.chalk.obj: Read the chalk note at the foot of a tower
quest.lifeguard_thesis.count.obj: Count the gulls through the binoculars
quest.lifeguard_thesis.desc: On the second tower a student sits writing a thesis about the Baltic. He needs a helper who can read chalk and is not afraid of gulls.
quest.lifeguard_thesis.done: A thought did come, not about the thesis but about how the sea is in no hurry and that is fine. The student put it in a footnote. The footnote turned out better than the chapter.
quest.lifeguard_thesis.gulls.log: The chapter on interference needs gulls: how many are on the buoys. Count them through the binoculars.
quest.lifeguard_thesis.log.log: Now compare it with the water log in the cabin: the student wants to know whether the board lies.
quest.lifeguard_thesis.rest.log: The student says the best thoughts come in the deck chair on the platform. Let us test that.
quest.lifeguard_thesis.sit.obj: Sit in the deck chair on the platform
quest.lifeguard_thesis.title: A thesis about water
quest.mineral_water.desc: The Druzhba sanatorium has a pump room. The guests go there on schedule, like going on a date.
quest.mineral_water.done: A taste of iron and of something warm. I drank it, and for a minute the sun seemed to shine from inside rather than out.
quest.mineral_water.drink.log: Now to drink it. Slowly, thinking of good things, as the sign says.
quest.mineral_water.fill.log: I'll fill a bottle at the tap by the entrance. They say the water comes out warm by itself, no heating at all.
quest.mineral_water.pump.obj: Fill a bottle of mineral water at the sanatorium
quest.mineral_water.title: Healing water
quest.photo_strip.booth.obj: Have my photo taken at the promenade studio
quest.photo_strip.desc: There isn't a single photo in my diary. Not even of me.
quest.photo_strip.done: I put the prints in my diary. The boy in them looks at me closely, as if he wants to ask something.
quest.photo_strip.photo.log: There's a photo studio on the promenade. Twenty roubles and I'll have proof I was here.
quest.photo_strip.title: A photo to remember
quest.px_maria.bell.log: The bell on the gallery can be heard from anywhere in the harbour. Anyone feeling for the entrance in fog will steer by its sound. I'll climb the spiral stair.
quest.px_maria.bell.obj: Ring the fog bell on the gallery
quest.px_maria.book.log: The clockwork's watch book lies by the stair under the clock. If Maria's truly in trouble, it will say so. I'll take a look.
quest.px_maria.book.obj: Read the clockwork's watch book downstairs
quest.px_maria.desc: The tower on the pier smells of coal and warm brass. A book lies open on the table, chalked across it: "If Maria isn't back by dawn, ring, don't be shy."
quest.px_maria.done: Fifteen minutes on the gallery and my hands smell of brass and sea. As I went down, the cat in his basket raised his head and looked as if to say: "There. Now we can sleep." The keepers left me a postcard of the lighthouse: "To one who helped keep the light."
quest.px_maria.lamp.log: The bell is heard, but a ship wants to see. The signal lamp on its tripod stands by the rail: three flashes and Maria will know she's awaited.
quest.px_maria.lamp.obj: Flash the signal lamp on the gallery
quest.px_maria.title: A light for Maria
quest.px_tea.cat.log: Just the cat's permission left to ask for. They say he grants it only to whoever brewed the tea properly.
quest.px_tea.cat.obj: Stroke the cat in the basket by the stove
quest.px_tea.cup.log: The tea is ready. I'll carry a cup to the watch desk, by the log. They'll see it the moment they return.
quest.px_tea.cup.obj: Set a cup of tea on the watch desk
quest.px_tea.desc: It's quiet inside the tower by the door. An empty kettle on the stove, a cold mug on the table, a slip: "Back by four. If you drop in, make yourself some. And for us, if you don't mind."
quest.px_tea.done: The cat in the basket opened an eye and, it seems, approved. Two cups stood on the table, one hot, one half-drunk. A note under them: "Thank you, stranger. You brew better than Aram, just don't tell him." They left me fifteen roubles for sweets.
quest.px_tea.kettle.log: The stove in the corner is still warm, logs in the wicker basket beside it. I'll put the kettle on: for me, for the keepers and, while I'm at it, for the cat.
quest.px_tea.kettle.obj: Boil the kettle on the stove
quest.px_tea.title: Tea for the keepers
quest.rassvet_reel.board.log: A sheet about the find is pinned to the foyer board. I'll read what it says.
quest.rassvet_reel.board.obj: Read the notice on the foyer board
quest.rassvet_reel.desc: At the Rassvet they have found a tin of film. The lid has the same word as the front of the building. The whole house is wondering what is on it.
quest.rassvet_reel.done: Nobody took the white light at the end for the end. We went out in silence, and the clerk slipped me a postcard: "In memory of what was never finished."
quest.rassvet_reel.piano.log: The sheet of the waltz from the old poster lies by the piano. I'll play at least a few bars.
quest.rassvet_reel.piano.obj: Play the piano in the foyer
quest.rassvet_reel.radio.log: The radio amateurs asked about this film on the air. I'll listen and see whether anyone has answered.
quest.rassvet_reel.screening.log: The screening is in the front row, one show only. A ticket is thirty roubles; the projectionist is in from three o'clock.
quest.rassvet_reel.screening.obj: Watch Rassvet from the front row
quest.rassvet_reel.title: The tin from the storeroom
quest.rcb_roof.desc: On the roof of the Ribbon Block Vitya keeps a pigeon loft, and the shop below sells seeds. The pigeons seem to be expecting a guest.
quest.rcb_roof.done: The pigeons ate from my hand, the tea had mint in it and the sea below turned pink. Vitya promised to show me Jupiter: four dots, the tripod on chalk.
quest.rcb_roof.pigeons.log: Now up to the roof, to the loft at the east end.
quest.rcb_roof.pigeons.obj: Feed the pigeons on the roof
quest.rcb_roof.seeds.log: Nina Pavlovna sells seeds in the corner shop, from morning to eight in the evening except Sundays.
quest.rcb_roof.seeds.obj: Buy sunflower seeds in the ground floor shop
quest.rcb_roof.tea.log: The samovar is on the table under the pergola. In the evening there's tea for everyone who comes.
quest.rcb_roof.title: Tea on the Roof
quest.rcb_socks.board.log: First I'll read the notices: whose sock, and what sock.
quest.rcb_socks.board.obj: Read the notice board in the laundry
quest.rcb_socks.box.log: The left one, with the darn, is probably in the Lost Property box under the shelf.
quest.rcb_socks.box.obj: Look in the Lost Property box
quest.rcb_socks.desc: The laundry's cork board has so many notices about one red sock that even the washing machines seem to be listening.
quest.rcb_socks.done: The pair is together. Nina Pavlovna said that evening Vitya walks round the yard as if he'd been given a bicycle. I got a warm thank-you and some tea.
quest.rcb_socks.line.log: The right sock hangs on the line over the table. I'll see what else is there.
quest.rcb_socks.line.obj: Look at the line of forgotten things
quest.rcb_socks.title: The Lone Sock
quest.sanatorium_guests.book.log: The guest book lies on the reception desk. It should be read a page a day, like letters: then you understand who these people are.
quest.sanatorium_guests.chess.log: They played chess by the dining-room window. I'll sit at the board, since the game is not finished.
quest.sanatorium_guests.chess.obj: Play a game at the chess corner
quest.sanatorium_guests.clock.log: The watchmaker was mending the clock over the pump room. I should see how it is now.
quest.sanatorium_guests.desc: In the Druzhba sanatorium the guest book turned out to be, entry after entry, about two people. I wonder how it ended.
quest.sanatorium_guests.done: I played slowly from the notebook, where every bar is labelled like a gear. The piano was half a tone off, and it seemed to me that was intended. Somewhere in the pump room the clock ticked loudly.
quest.sanatorium_guests.piano.log: A notebook of music was left on the winter-garden piano. It should not lie there for nothing.
quest.sanatorium_guests.piano.obj: Play the piano in the winter garden
quest.sanatorium_guests.read.obj: Read an entry in the guest book
quest.sanatorium_guests.title: Two holidaymakers
quest.sanatorium_regime.board.log: First find out what is planned: the schedule hangs by the entrance, to the right of the doors.
quest.sanatorium_regime.desc: Everything at the sanatorium runs by the clock: water, treatments, the quiet hour. I want to live one day by the regime, like a real holidaymaker.
quest.sanatorium_regime.done: The day went exactly by the regime. Even time seemed to pass in small sips. No tiredness, just a strange lightness, as after a good oxygen cocktail.
quest.sanatorium_regime.oxygen.log: On the schedule is an oxygen cocktail. The bar is in the dining hall by the courtyard windows. Twelve roubles, they say, is cheap for a cloud.
quest.sanatorium_regime.pump.obj: Take water at the pump room
quest.sanatorium_regime.regime.obj: Read the daily regime by the entrance
quest.sanatorium_regime.rest.log: After the water and the foam, a rest. The winter garden, an armchair among the palms, a book from the trolley.
quest.sanatorium_regime.title: A holidaymaker's regime
quest.sanatorium_regime.water.log: Water comes first: the pump room, small sips, no hurry.
quest.school_bag.bag.obj: Look behind the mats in the gym
quest.school_bag.box.log: It is not in the cloakroom. I'll look in the lost-and-found box in the hall.
quest.school_bag.desc: A notice in School No. 1's wall newspaper says a blue bag is missing. The whole school seems to be looking for it, except those who know where it is.
quest.school_bag.done: The bag sits on the bench by the gym door: blue, with an inked "L.K." They say the wall newspaper will soon have a line about the unknown person who brought it back. And Lyosha is probably already jumping. In sneakers.
quest.school_bag.gazette.obj: Read the wall newspaper in the hall
quest.school_bag.gym.log: The note in the box points to the gym. I'll look behind the mats.
quest.school_bag.notice.log: First the notice in the wall newspaper, which hangs in the hall.
quest.school_bag.title: The lost gym bag
quest.school_concert.desc: A poster for Saturday's concert hangs in the hall, and the music room, it seems, is short of a pianist.
quest.school_concert.done: I played twice: the first time by the notes, the second as I wished. The music teacher said I'd be expected at the concert and gave me a badge to remember it by.
quest.school_concert.keys.obj: Play the piano in the music room
quest.school_concert.piano.log: I'll go to the music room and try the piano.
quest.school_concert.poster.log: I'll read the poster in the hall: they seem to want a pianist.
quest.school_concert.stage.log: A rehearsal without a stage is no rehearsal. To the gym, then.
quest.school_concert.title: Song about the Sea
quest.school_lesson.board.log: The teacher said: "New boy, to the board!" Well then. To the board.
quest.school_lesson.desc: You can hear School No. 1's bell from the street. I wonder if anyone would notice if I quietly sat at the back.
quest.school_lesson.desk.obj: Sit through a lesson at the school
quest.school_lesson.done: Got a B for an answer I don't remember giving. The teacher said: "Come again, there'll always be a place for you here."
quest.school_lesson.lesson.log: Lessons run on weekdays from eight till three. I'll find a classroom and a free desk.
quest.school_lesson.title: The lesson
quest.store_errand.buy.log: The grocery counter on the ground floor has kefir and bread. I'll buy them while I'm here.
quest.store_errand.deliver.log: Now to the Stepped House, flat 4. I'll leave the bag at the door and sit on the bench outside for a bit, in case she looks out.
quest.store_errand.desc: A note on the department store door: "Anyone going to the Stepped House: please bring kefir and a loaf to flat 4. Money under the mat. Thank you!"
quest.store_errand.done: While I sat on the bench the bag by the door vanished. Under the mat: the money and a note: "You're a good person. Come round for tea." No signature.
quest.store_errand.stepped_house.obj: Take the shopping to the Stepped House and sit outside
quest.store_errand.title: A note on the door
quest.store_fitting.booth.obj: Listen to a record in the booth
quest.store_fitting.cubicle.obj: Try something on in the fitting room
quest.store_fitting.desc: In the department store you don't have to buy anything, but you can't help noticing it. A window, a fitting room, records: I'll try to be a proper customer and spend nothing.
quest.store_fitting.done: I left the store with empty hands and a full head: a waltz in one ear, and a "well, how is it?" from behind a curtain in the other. The assistants seem to have smiled after me.
quest.store_fitting.fit.log: Upstairs in the clothes department there's a fitting room with a curtain. I'll try something on, anything.
quest.store_fitting.listen.log: In the records department there's a listening booth. I can't buy a record, but nobody forbids listening.
quest.store_fitting.title: Being a Customer
quest.store_fitting.window.log: I'll start with the window: in the morning someone usually works there, and by day it's simply pretty.
quest.store_umbrella.announce.obj: Announce over the loudspeaker that the umbrella has been found
quest.store_umbrella.cloak.log: First I'll look into the stand by the cloakroom: umbrellas like to turn up there on their own.
quest.store_umbrella.desc: The lost and found has announced the yellow umbrella again; this time it was found in the toy department. The umbrella seems to wander the store by itself. I should find out where it is today and tell its owner.
quest.store_umbrella.done: For a second everybody in the hall froze, then somebody clapped. A minute later a woman in a checked scarf came to the bureau, took the umbrella and said "thank you" in a voice she'd clearly rehearsed a hundred times. The duck on the handle winked at me. Or I imagined it.
quest.store_umbrella.lost.log: It isn't here, or isn't any more. I'll ask at the lost and found: they have their own stand and their own tag.
quest.store_umbrella.mic.log: The owner, they say, loves to hear her name over the radio. The bureau has allowed me to tell her myself, through the microphone, that the umbrella has been found.
quest.store_umbrella.shelf.obj: Look at the umbrellas at the lost and found
quest.store_umbrella.stand.obj: Look into the umbrella stand by the cloakroom
quest.store_umbrella.title: The Yellow Umbrella with the Duck
quest.t3_bowl.desc: There's a pottery studio in the brick hall. The potter promised: in a week a lump of clay becomes a bowl. A week is a lot, but I'm in no hurry.
quest.t3_bowl.done: Green as the sea on a grey day, with two blue specks and one side a little higher than the other. The potter said: "It's alive." I'll pour tea into it.
quest.t3_bowl.fire.log: The bowl went off to dry, then into the kiln. I'll look in at the kiln and see how it's getting on.
quest.t3_bowl.glaze.log: After the first firing the bowl is pink as a piglet. Time to colour it: green, blue, and the "do not touch" one stays untouched.
quest.t3_bowl.glaze.obj: Glaze the bowl at the bench
quest.t3_bowl.take.log: The second firing is done. All that's left is to find my bowl on the shelf among the others.
quest.t3_bowl.take.obj: Look over the shelf of finished ware
quest.t3_bowl.throw.log: I'll start at the wheel: centre, pull up the walls, not press but persuade.
quest.t3_bowl.title: Bowl No. 7
quest.t3_fifth.ask.log: To start with I'll just go up to the coach. Just talk, promise nothing.
quest.t3_fifth.desc: At the sports centre the "Surf Juniors" are one player short for the courtyard tournament. The coach is looking at me as if I'd do. That's dangerous.
quest.t3_fifth.done: We took second place. Locker No. 5 now has my name and a certificate is waiting for me at the till. The coach said: "One more time?" I think I said yes.
quest.t3_fifth.play.log: Taya said I shoot "almost scarily." All that's left is to step on the court and play for real.
quest.t3_fifth.title: Number five
quest.t3_fifth.train.log: The coach said: "Come at five." To warm up I'll shoot at the back-wall hoop while nobody's watching.
quest.unit_herring.ask.log: Shrimp in my pocket. I'll ask the fishmonger how best to thread it.
quest.unit_herring.bait.log: To fish for herring off the pier you need bait. The shop has shrimp.
quest.unit_herring.desc: At the fish shop, next to the tide table, news about the herring is written in chalk. I'll find out how the waiting ended.
quest.unit_herring.done: The fishmonger looked at the shrimp, then at me, and said: "Silence matters more." I'll go to the pier tomorrow, when they bite on silence.
quest.unit_herring.read_tides.obj: Read the tide table at the fish shop
quest.unit_herring.tides.log: Chalk on the tide table says there's no herring yet. I'll read what it says today.
quest.unit_herring.title: Herring at the pier
quest.unit_regatta.ask_renter.obj: Ask at the rental counter about the race
quest.unit_regatta.boats.log: A school blackboard at the rentals with the boat schedule and a notice. I'll read it.
quest.unit_regatta.desc: At the rentals a school blackboard talks of boats and some kind of race. I wonder whether there's really a place for me.
quest.unit_regatta.done: "I don't take singles, they row in circles," the owner said. But he left a spot for me on the list. Now I have to find a partner by Saturday.
quest.unit_regatta.read_boats.obj: Read the boat schedule at the rentals
quest.unit_regatta.rest.log: While the board thinks, I'll sit in the deckchair by the window and watch the sea. Boats are best watched seated.
quest.unit_regatta.sign.log: All that's left is to ask at the counter about a place in the race.
quest.unit_regatta.sit_chair.obj: Sit in the deckchair by the window
quest.unit_regatta.title: The Race to the Buoy
quest.unit_valve.ask_barista.obj: Talk to the barista at the Seagull café
quest.unit_valve.board.log: The board by the café door says the Leningrad is waiting for a valve. I'll look in at the repair shop; they should know.
quest.unit_valve.cafe_board.obj: Read the board at the Seagull café
quest.unit_valve.cup.log: If the tags are right the machine will soon sing. I'll ask the barista whether it's time for a cup.
quest.unit_valve.desc: The Seagull café's board talks about a poorly coffee machine. I'm curious how it will end.
quest.unit_valve.done: The machine is back in the café and the first cup smells new: of a fish-shop valve and a little pride. The barista poured me one without asking.
quest.unit_valve.shop_tags.obj: Read the tags in the repair shop
quest.unit_valve.tags.log: The repair shop has numbered tags on nails. I need the one about the coffee machine.
quest.unit_valve.title: A valve for the Leningrad
